question: Who is appointed as CEO of Air India Express in November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aloke Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aloke Singh** was appointed as the **CEO of Air India Express** in **November 2020**.
 
• He took over the position during a critical phase for the airline industry, which was heavily impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Aloke Singh has extensive experience in the aviation sector, having held various leadership roles in airlines and related businesses.
 
• His appointment is aimed at steering the **low-cost carrier towards better operational efficiency and service quality**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Air India Express is a wholly owned subsidiary of Air India, focusing on **short-haul international flights**, primarily to the** Middle East and Southeast Asia**.
 
• The airline was established in **2005 **and operates a **fleet of Boeing 737 aircraft**.
 
• Air India Express is known for its low-cost structure while providing essential services to expatriates and tourists.
 
• In recent years, the airline has been expanding its network and enhancing its service offerings to compete more effectively in the low-cost carrier market.
